thread:
mina: quick sync note 1: prototyping a minimal 'precision negotiator' proto to let planner pick fp8/int8/4bit per model, with per-tenant min-bitpath and an optional quality_hint. feedback?

otto: love it. two immediate asks: 1) policy must include policy_version and admin_change_ts for audits, 2) enforce tenant min-bitpath precedence.

li: runtime flag: default no mid-flight changes for cached sessions. tokenwise ramp should be explicitly enabled and limited to stateless calls.

mina: agreed. proto sketch (informal): model_id, default_bitpath, allowed_bitpaths, tenant_overrides, module_overrides, ramp_config, policy_version. keep it tiny.

tara: ops notes: KV cache format incompat is the biggest risk. prefer versioned cache keys: model#policyv#bitpath. add cache_miss_rate metric to detect regressions.

otto: telemetry required: chosen_bitpath, policy_version, deg_score, quality_hint, prompt_fingerprint, p95_latency, cache_key_version. Without these we won't debug rollouts.

li: fallback order proposal: try chosen bitpath -> retry on int8 variant (same model) -> route to high-fidelity pool -> surface controlled error. auto-rollback on sustained deg_score regressions.

devops-bot: canary created: precision-negotiator/copper-lite -> 2% traffic, shadow-int8 enabled. link: https://infra/redwood/canaries/precision-negotiator-2pc

tara: testing checklist: planner unit tests, shadow-eval anchors, cache-growth sim, limited transcoder tests if we enable conversions later.

mina: next steps: I'll draft RFC follow-up with exact proto, telemetry keys, and fallback thresholds. tagging @infra and @oncall for review. thanks!
